Provenance of the Jev (TypeSafe System One) fixtures used by src/jev.rs tests.

recorded_choice_noul.json
  A real System One response, recorded 2026-10-04 by the cree8-video-editor
  client and kept there as RECORDED in lib/server/typesafe_test.ts. Copied
  verbatim; it is the only recorded shape here.

rank_batch_1.json, rank_batch_2.json   -- SYNTHETIC
  Hand-written in the recorded shape (model, answers.<id>.{type, choice,
  probabilities, confidence}, usage.{input_tokens, output_tokens}) for the
  chat-ranking question "relevant". No TYPESAFE_API_KEY was available when
  TRU-141 was written, so these were not captured from the live API. Unlike
  a live answer they list only a few options' probabilities; the client
  treats an unlisted option as probability 0. Replace them with a capture
  from `cargo run --example jev_rank_smoke` once a key is at hand.

rank_request.json   -- SYNTHETIC (golden)
  The request body src/jev.rs must build for a two-chat ranking call; it
  pins the wire field names (state, model, questions.<id>.type /
  instructions / criteria) taken from the reference client and
  https://docs.typesafe.ai/api.md.
